Файл целостный. Публикую изменения.

```json
{"version":1,"taskId":"fd5dc768-2e5c-404a-9426-c8cc952cd365","commandId":"publish-1","operation":"publish","headSha":"e0a720a0b8185824d35e09937c677a9ed3d5752e","message":"fix(runtime): lava, force volumes, pads and fields act as sensors instead of walls

HoleRuntime now routes every authored volume through src/obstacles/descriptors:
hazards (including lava) keep their trigger patch plus the gameplay zone that
dictates penalty and respawn, teleporters/fans/conveyors become force obstacles,
spring/boost/jump pads become impulse pads and gravity/magnet volumes register
in a ZoneManager. None of them create a collider any more, so volcano lava pools,
the candy-factory belts and the layout-kit teleporters stop behaving like walls.

Game applies the new applyBallEffects() each fixed step while a shot is live and
resets teleporter latches and pad cooldowns per turn.

Tests: src/game/holeRuntime.test.ts covers the volcano-3 lava drop (+2 strokes,
reset to the last safe position), the cf-07 conveyor drift, a layout-kit teleporter
exit and a boost pad; npm test (243 tests) and npm run build pass."}
```
